name: fiu-finance-mcp
description: FIU Finance MCP assistant — quotes, order book, K-line, fundamentals, shareholding, IPO, ETF, bonds, US options, news and reference data for HK, US, A-share, Japan and global fixed income.
author: FIU AI

requiredEnvVars.name: FIU_MCP_GATEWAY_AUTHORIZATION
requiredEnvVars.description: Authorization header value for the FIU MCP gateway, in the form 'Bearer <API_KEY>'. Get an API key at http://ai.szfiu.com.

optionalEnvVars.name: FIU_MCP_URL
optionalEnvVars.description: Override the MCP endpoint. Defaults to http://ai.szfiu.com/api/mcp/v2.
